title: Newspaper: Politics & Government
sub: Words you meet daily in headlines on elections, laws, and governance.

cards.def:
Laws collectively, or the process of making them.
हिंदी: कानून / विधान
examples: Present: The parliament debates new legislation every session.
Past: The government passed sweeping legislation last year.
Future: The new legislation will take effect in April.
Perfect: Lawmakers have drafted legislation on data privacy.

cards.def:
An alliance of parties joining to govern or act together.
हिंदी: गठबंधन
examples: Present: A coalition rules the state.
Past: The parties formed a coalition after the vote.
Future: The coalition will face a tough test in the budget.
Perfect: The coalition has held together for two years.

cards.def:
Parties or people who resist the government's policies.
हिंदी: विपक्ष
examples: Present: The opposition criticises every budget.
Past: The opposition walked out of the house.
Future: The opposition will challenge the bill in court.
Perfect: The opposition has demanded a debate.

cards.def:
The authority to act given by voters.
हिंदी: जनादेश
examples: Present: A strong mandate lets a party act boldly.
Past: Voters gave her a clear mandate.
Future: The mandate will shape the next five years.
Perfect: The party has claimed a mandate for reform.

cards.def:
The person currently holding an office.
हिंदी: पदधारी
examples: Present: The incumbent usually has a funding edge.
Past: The incumbent lost by a narrow margin.
Future: The incumbent will seek a second term.
Perfect: The incumbent has led the polls all year.

cards.def:
A district whose voters elect a representative.
हिंदी: निर्वाचन क्षेत्र
examples: Present: She visits her constituency every weekend.
Past: He won his constituency by ten thousand votes.
Future: The constituency will vote on Sunday.
Perfect: The constituency has elected the same party since 1990.

cards.def:
All the people entitled to vote.
हिंदी: मतदाता वर्ग
examples: Present: The electorate expects jobs and stable prices.
Past: The electorate rejected the ruling party.
Future: The electorate will decide in November.
Perfect: The electorate has grown younger.

cards.def:
A vote, or the paper or system used to cast it.
हिंदी: मतपत्र / मतदान
examples: Present: Each voter casts a ballot in secret.
Past: Millions cast their ballot yesterday.
Future: Counting of the ballot will begin at dawn.
Perfect: Officials have secured every ballot box.

cards.def:
To work in an organised way to win votes or support.
हिंदी: अभियान चलाना
examples: Present: She campaigns on healthcare.
Past: He campaigned across ten states.
Future: They will campaign door to door.
Perfect: The party has campaigned for months.

cards.def:
A published statement of a party's aims.
हिंदी: घोषणापत्र
examples: Present: Every party releases a manifesto before polls.
Past: The party released its manifesto in March.
Future: The manifesto will promise free education.
Perfect: The party has revised its manifesto.

cards.def:
A direct vote on a single question.
हिंदी: जनमत संग्रह
examples: Present: A referendum lets citizens decide one issue.
Past: The country held a referendum on independence.
Future: A referendum will settle the matter.
Perfect: The nation has never held a referendum before.

cards.def:
A formal change to a law or constitution.
हिंदी: संशोधन
examples: Present: An amendment needs a two-thirds majority.
Past: Parliament passed the amendment unanimously.
Future: The amendment will protect free speech.
Perfect: Lawmakers have proposed an amendment.

cards.def:
To officially reject a proposed law.
हिंदी: वीटो करना
examples: Present: The president can veto a bill.
Past: The governor vetoed the budget.
Future: The president will veto the measure.
Perfect: She has vetoed three bills this year.

cards.def:
To formally approve a treaty or agreement.
हिंदी: अनुमोदन करना
examples: Present: Members ratify the treaty by vote.
Past: The senate ratified the pact last week.
Future: Parliament will ratify the deal soon.
Perfect: Twenty countries have ratified the accord.

cards.def:
To formally end a parliament or assembly.
हिंदी: भंग करना
examples: Present: The president dissolves the house on advice.
Past: The prime minister dissolved parliament.
Future: The assembly will dissolve in June.
Perfect: The council has dissolved itself.

cards.def:
To charge a public official with serious misconduct.
हिंदी: महाभियोग चलाना
examples: Present: Congress can impeach a president.
Past: The house impeached the judge.
Future: Lawmakers will impeach him if he refuses.
Perfect: They have impeached two officials.

cards.def:
To voluntarily leave a job or position.
हिंदी: इस्तीफ़ा देना
examples: Present: Ministers resign when scandals break.
Past: The minister resigned on Monday.
Future: She will resign next month.
Perfect: He has resigned from the cabinet.

cards.def:
To choose someone for a job or role.
हिंदी: नियुक्त करना
examples: Present: The president appoints the judges.
Past: They appointed a new chief secretary.
Future: The board will appoint a successor.
Perfect: The cabinet has appointed an envoy.

cards.def:
To publicly support a person or plan.
हिंदी: समर्थन करना
examples: Present: Unions endorse the candidate.
Past: The newspaper endorsed her campaign.
Future: The party will endorse the proposal.
Perfect: Several mayors have endorsed the plan.

cards.def:
To refuse to take part as a protest.
हिंदी: बहिष्कार करना
examples: Present: Some members boycott the session.
Past: The opposition boycotted the vote.
Future: They will boycott the ceremony.
Perfect: Voters have boycotted the polls.

cards.def:
A long speech meant to delay a vote.
हिंदी: लंबा भाषण देकर बाधा डालना
examples: Present: A filibuster can stall a bill.
Past: The senator filibustered for ten hours.
Future: The minority will filibuster the bill.
Perfect: They have filibustered all week.

cards.def:
Involving two main political parties.
हिंदी: द्विदलीय
examples: Present: A bipartisan bill has wide support.
Past: A bipartisan group drafted the law.
Future: A bipartisan panel will review it.
Perfect: Both sides have reached a bipartisan deal.

cards.def:
Strongly supporting one party or cause.
हिंदी: पक्षपाती
examples: Present: Partisan debates rarely change minds.
Past: The hearing turned partisan quickly.
Future: Media coverage will stay partisan.
Perfect: The issue has become highly partisan.

cards.def:
Open to new ideas and individual freedoms.
हिंदी: उदारवादी
examples: Present: She holds liberal views on trade.
Past: The party took a liberal stance.
Future: A liberal government will cut barriers.
Perfect: He has always been liberal on social issues.

cards.def:
Favouring traditional values and gradual change.
हिंदी: रूढ़िवादी
examples: Present: He is conservative about spending.
Past: The bank adopted a conservative strategy.
Future: A conservative government will cut taxes.
Perfect: She has remained conservative in her views.

cards.def:
Far-reaching and extreme in change sought.
हिंदी: आमूलचूल / उग्र
examples: Present: Radical ideas often meet resistance.
Past: The minister proposed a radical reform.
Future: The plan will bring radical changes.
Perfect: He has always held radical views.

cards.def:
Avoiding extremes; reasonable.
हिंदी: मध्यम मार्गी
examples: Present: Moderate voters decide most elections.
Past: She struck a moderate tone.
Future: The party will choose a moderate leader.
Perfect: He has remained moderate throughout.

cards.def:
A system where citizens choose their rulers by voting.
हिंदी: लोकतंत्र
examples: Present: A democracy protects free speech.
Past: The nation became a democracy in 1950.
Future: A strong democracy will outlast crises.
Perfect: The country has remained a democracy.

cards.def:
Rule by one person with unlimited power.
हिंदी: निरंकुश शासन
examples: Present: An autocracy silences critics.
Past: The country slid into autocracy.
Future: Autocracy will fail without public trust.
Perfect: The state has drifted toward autocracy.

cards.def:
A government, especially a harsh or undemocratic one.
हिंदी: शासन-व्यवस्था
examples: Present: The regime controls the press.
Past: The regime collapsed in 1991.
Future: The regime will face sanctions.
Perfect: The regime has jailed many critics.

cards.def:
Having supreme, independent authority.
हिंदी: संप्रभु
examples: Present: A sovereign nation makes its own laws.
Past: The island became a sovereign state in 1960.
Future: The territory will remain sovereign.
Perfect: The state has declared itself sovereign.

cards.def:
Managing relations between countries peacefully.
हिंदी: कूटनीति
examples: Present: Quiet diplomacy often avoids war.
Past: Diplomacy ended the standoff.
Future: Diplomacy will be tested at the summit.
Perfect: Envoys have relied on diplomacy for years.

cards.def:
A representative sent on a special mission.
हिंदी: दूत
examples: Present: The envoy meets leaders abroad.
Past: The envoy travelled to Geneva.
Future: The envoy will deliver the message.
Perfect: The envoy has met both sides.

cards.def:
An ambassador's offices in a foreign country.
हिंदी: दूतावास
examples: Present: The embassy helps citizens abroad.
Past: Protesters gathered outside the embassy.
Future: The embassy will reopen next week.
Perfect: The embassy has issued a travel warning.

cards.def:
A penalty imposed on a country for breaking rules.
हिंदी: प्रतिबंध
examples: Present: Sanctions hurt the economy.
Past: The UN imposed sanctions in 2018.
Future: New sanctions will target banks.
Perfect: Several nations have eased sanctions.

cards.def:
A meeting of top leaders.
हिंदी: शिखर सम्मेलन
examples: Present: The summit brings leaders together yearly.
Past: The summit ended without a deal.
Future: The summit will focus on climate.
Perfect: Leaders have attended the summit.

cards.def:
A formal agreement between countries.
हिंदी: संधि
examples: Present: A treaty binds all signatories.
Past: They signed the treaty in 1998.
Future: The treaty will ban nuclear tests.
Perfect: Many nations have joined the treaty.

cards.def:
A union formed for shared aims.
हिंदी: गठजोड़
examples: Present: An alliance gives members security.
Past: The two nations formed an alliance.
Future: The alliance will expand next year.
Perfect: The alliance has grown stronger.

cards.def:
Involving two parties or countries.
हिंदी: द्विपक्षीय
examples: Present: Bilateral trade is growing.
Past: The leaders held bilateral talks.
Future: A bilateral deal will be signed.
Perfect: The nations have signed a bilateral pact.

cards.def:
Involving three or more countries.
हिंदी: बहुपक्षीय
examples: Present: Multilateral talks are complex.
Past: They pursued multilateral negotiations.
Future: A multilateral agency will oversee it.
Perfect: Nations have backed multilateral action.

cards.def:
To take over territory and add it to one's own.
हिंदी: कब्ज़ा करना / मिला लेना
examples: Present: Some states annex neighbouring land.
Past: The empire annexed the province.
Future: The state will annex the region.
Perfect: They have annexed the border villages.

cards.def:
A person forced to flee their country.
हिंदी: शरणार्थी
examples: Present: A refugee needs shelter and safety.
Past: Thousands of refugees crossed the border.
Future: Refugees will receive temporary housing.
Perfect: The camp has sheltered refugees for years.

cards.def:
Protection given by a country to someone fleeing danger.
हिंदी: शरण
examples: Present: Asylum protects those facing persecution.
Past: She was granted asylum in Canada.
Future: He will seek asylum next month.
Perfect: Thousands have applied for asylum.

cards.def:
Moving to a foreign country to live.
हिंदी: आव्रजन
examples: Present: Immigration shapes the labour market.
Past: Immigration rose sharply in the 2000s.
Future: Immigration will remain a key issue.
Perfect: Immigration has changed the city.

cards.def:
To expel someone from a country.
हिंदी: निर्वासित करना
examples: Present: Authorities deport illegal entrants.
Past: They deported the traveller.
Future: Officials will deport him tomorrow.
Perfect: The country has deported hundreds.

cards.def:
A change made to improve a system.
हिंदी: सुधार
examples: Present: Reform can reduce corruption.
Past: The reform changed the pension system.
Future: Reform will begin next year.
Perfect: The government has promised reform.

cards.def:
Money given by government to lower the cost of something.
हिंदी: सब्सिडी / अनुदान
examples: Present: A subsidy helps farmers.
Past: The state cut the fuel subsidy.
Future: A subsidy will support solar power.
Perfect: Farmers have received subsidies for years.

cards.def:
A plan of expected income and spending.
हिंदी: बजट
examples: Present: The budget funds public services.
Past: The finance minister presented the budget.
Future: The budget will cut deficits.
Perfect: The cabinet has approved the budget.

cards.def:
The amount by which spending exceeds income.
हिंदी: घाटा
examples: Present: A large deficit worries investors.
Past: The deficit widened last year.
Future: The deficit will fall by next year.
Perfect: The deficit has doubled.

cards.def:
To set aside money or resources for a purpose.
हिंदी: आवंटित करना
examples: Present: Governments allocate funds yearly.
Past: They allocated billions to roads.
Future: The state will allocate more to schools.
Perfect: The council has allocated land for housing.

cards.def:
A plan of action adopted by a government.
हिंदी: नीति
examples: Present: Policy shapes daily life.
Past: The policy angered farmers.
Future: The policy will begin in January.
Perfect: The ministry has changed its policy.

cards.def:
A new plan or action to solve a problem.
हिंदी: पहल
examples: Present: The initiative targets rural health.
Past: The mayor launched an initiative for clean water.
Future: The initiative will train young workers.
Perfect: The ministry has launched a new initiative.

cards.def:
To control by rules.
हिंदी: नियंत्रित करना
examples: Present: The agency regulates drug prices.
Past: The law regulated gambling.
Future: New rules will regulate online platforms.
Perfect: The state has regulated rents.

cards.def:
To make sure a rule is obeyed.
हिंदी: लागू करना
examples: Present: Police enforce traffic laws.
Past: The court enforced the order.
Future: Inspectors will enforce the ban.
Perfect: The agency has enforced strict rules.

cards.def:
To officially end a system or practice.
हिंदी: समाप्त करना
examples: Present: Some argue we should abolish the tax.
Past: The nation abolished slavery in 1833.
Future: The state will abolish the levy.
Perfect: Several countries have abolished the death penalty.

cards.def:
A thorough examination and improvement of a system.
हिंदी: आमूल सुधार
examples: Present: The system needs an overhaul.
Past: The government announced an overhaul of schools.
Future: The overhaul will take two years.
Perfect: Ministers have called for an overhaul.

cards.def:
Causing public disagreement.
हिंदी: विवादास्पद
examples: Present: A controversial law divides opinion.
Past: The decision was controversial.
Future: The proposal will be controversial.
Perfect: The speech has proven controversial.

cards.def:
An event that shocks the public because of wrongdoing.
हिंदी: घोटाला
examples: Present: A scandal can end a career.
Past: The scandal rocked the ministry.
Future: The scandal will hurt the party.
Perfect: A new scandal has emerged.

cards.def:
Dishonest use of power for personal gain.
हिंदी: भ्रष्टाचार
examples: Present: Corruption drains public funds.
Past: Corruption led to the minister's downfall.
Future: Reform will reduce corruption.
Perfect: Investigators have exposed corruption.

cards.def:
Openness about decisions and actions.
हिंदी: पारदर्शिता
examples: Present: Transparency builds public trust.
Past: The audit demanded more transparency.
Future: The law will improve transparency.
Perfect: Activists have demanded transparency.

cards.def:
Being responsible for one's actions and answerable for them.
हिंदी: जवाबदेही
examples: Present: Accountability keeps officials honest.
Past: The inquiry demanded accountability.
Future: Voters will demand accountability.
Perfect: The press has pushed for accountability.

cards.def:
A system of administration with many rules and officials.
हिंदी: नौकरशाही
examples: Present: Bureaucracy slows decisions.
Past: Bureaucracy delayed the project.
Future: Reform will cut bureaucracy.
Perfect: Red tape has grown with bureaucracy.

cards.def:
The area or matters over which an authority has power.
हिंदी: अधिकार क्षेत्र
examples: Present: The court has jurisdiction over contracts.
Past: The case fell outside its jurisdiction.
Future: The new agency will have national jurisdiction.
Perfect: The matter has moved to federal jurisdiction.

cards.def:
Relating to a system where power is shared between central and state governments.
हिंदी: संघीय
examples: Present: Federal laws apply nationwide.
Past: The federal court overturned the ruling.
Future: A federal grant will fund the project.
Perfect: The state has joined the federal scheme.

cards.def:
Relating to a city or town government.
हिंदी: नगरपालिका संबंधी
examples: Present: Municipal services include waste collection.
Past: The municipal body repaired the roads.
Future: A municipal election will be held in May.
Perfect: The council has raised municipal taxes.

cards.def:
The senior ministers who advise a head of government.
हिंदी: मंत्रिमंडल
examples: Present: The cabinet meets weekly.
Past: The cabinet approved the plan.
Future: The cabinet will meet on Friday.
Perfect: The cabinet has reshuffled twice.

cards.def:
A change in the positions of ministers or staff.
हिंदी: फेरबदल
examples: Present: A reshuffle can signal a new direction.
Past: The prime minister announced a reshuffle.
Future: A reshuffle will follow the elections.
Perfect: The party has seen another reshuffle.

cards.def:
A person who speaks officially for a group.
हिंदी: प्रवक्ता
examples: Present: The spokesperson briefs the media daily.
Past: The spokesperson denied the claim.
Future: The spokesperson will address reporters.
Perfect: The spokesperson has issued a statement.

cards.def:
A claim that someone has done wrong, not yet proven.
हिंदी: आरोप
examples: Present: An allegation requires evidence.
Past: The minister dismissed the allegation.
Future: Police will investigate the allegation.
Perfect: Several allegations have surfaced.

cards.def:
An investigation into something.
हिंदी: जाँच
examples: Present: A probe may take months.
Past: A probe revealed major errors.
Future: Authorities will launch a probe.
Perfect: The agency has begun a probe.

cards.def:
A formal investigation.
हिंदी: जाँच-पड़ताल
examples: Present: An inquiry seeks the facts.
Past: The inquiry blamed poor planning.
Future: The inquiry will report in May.
Perfect: The panel has opened an inquiry.

cards.def:
A statement given under oath.
हिंदी: गवाही
examples: Present: Testimony helps reveal the truth.
Past: Her testimony shocked the court.
Future: His testimony will begin Monday.
Perfect: The witness has given powerful testimony.

cards.def:
To make secret information known.
हिंदी: खुलासा करना
examples: Present: Firms must disclose their earnings.
Past: He disclosed the details to reporters.
Future: The ministry will disclose the figures.
Perfect: The company has disclosed the loss.

cards.def:
To let secret information become public.
हिंदी: लीक करना
examples: Present: Insiders sometimes leak documents.
Past: Someone leaked the memo.
Future: Aides will likely leak the plan.
Perfect: The report has leaked online.

cards.def:
To promise solemnly.
हिंदी: वादा करना
examples: Present: Leaders pledge support in speeches.
Past: She pledged to cut taxes.
Future: The party will pledge free schooling.
Perfect: Donors have pledged billions.

cards.def:
To strongly encourage someone to act.
हिंदी: आग्रह करना
examples: Present: Doctors urge people to exercise.
Past: Leaders urged calm.
Future: The UN will urge restraint.
Perfect: Experts have urged action.

cards.def:
To express strong disapproval.
हिंदी: निंदा करना
examples: Present: Leaders condemn violence.
Past: The president condemned the attack.
Future: The council will condemn the move.
Perfect: Many nations have condemned the decision.

cards.def:
To publicly support a cause.
हिंदी: वकालत करना
examples: Present: She advocates for women's rights.
Past: He advocated lower taxes.
Future: They will advocate for change.
Perfect: Groups have advocated reform.

cards.def:
A disagreement or argument.
हिंदी: विवाद
examples: Present: A dispute can delay a project.
Past: The dispute lasted a decade.
Future: The dispute will go to court.
Perfect: The neighbours have settled their dispute.

cards.def:
A situation where no progress is possible.
हिंदी: गतिरोध
examples: Present: A stalemate frustrates both sides.
Past: The talks ended in stalemate.
Future: A stalemate will prolong the strike.
Perfect: The negotiations have reached a stalemate.

cards.def:
An agreement where each side gives something up.
हिंदी: समझौता
examples: Present: Compromise keeps peace.
Past: They reached a compromise on funding.
Future: A compromise will be announced soon.
Perfect: Both sides have accepted a compromise.

cards.def:
General agreement among a group.
हिंदी: आम सहमति
examples: Present: Consensus is hard to build.
Past: The panel reached a consensus.
Future: A consensus will emerge by evening.
Perfect: Experts have formed a consensus.

cards.def:
Agreed by everyone.
हिंदी: सर्वसम्मत
examples: Present: A unanimous vote is rare.
Past: The decision was unanimous.
Future: The vote will likely be unanimous.
Perfect: The board has been unanimous.

cards.def:
The minimum number of members needed to hold a meeting.
हिंदी: गणपूर्ति
examples: Present: A quorum is needed to vote.
Past: The meeting lacked a quorum.
Future: The house will reach a quorum soon.
Perfect: The committee has met its quorum.

cards.def:
To break off a meeting until later.
हिंदी: स्थगित करना
examples: Present: Courts adjourn for lunch.
Past: The speaker adjourned the house.
Future: The session will adjourn at noon.
Perfect: Parliament has adjourned for the day.

cards.def:
A decision on a disputed matter, especially by a jury.
हिंदी: फ़ैसला
examples: Present: The verdict ends the trial.
Past: The jury delivered its verdict.
Future: The verdict will arrive tomorrow.
Perfect: The court has reached a verdict.

cards.def:
A small-scale trial of a plan.
हिंदी: प्रायोगिक योजना
examples: Present: A pilot tests an idea cheaply.
Past: The pilot ran in three towns.
Future: The pilot will begin in May.
Perfect: The state has completed the pilot.

cards.def:
A person or group with an interest in a decision.
हिंदी: हितधारक
examples: Present: Stakeholders influence policy.
Past: Officials consulted every stakeholder.
Future: Stakeholders will meet next week.
Perfect: Stakeholders have raised concerns.

cards.def:
Involving ordinary people at the local level.
हिंदी: जमीनी स्तर का
examples: Present: Grassroots movements shape politics.
Past: A grassroots campaign toppled the bill.
Future: Grassroots support will decide the result.
Perfect: Volunteers have built a grassroots network.

cards.def:
To try to influence lawmakers.
हिंदी: पैरवी करना
examples: Present: Firms lobby for favourable rules.
Past: Farmers lobbied the minister.
Future: Groups will lobby the committee.
Perfect: The industry has lobbied for years.

cards.def:
A vote, or a survey of opinion.
हिंदी: चुनाव / सर्वेक्षण
examples: Present: A poll shows public mood.
Past: The poll gave her a lead.
Future: The poll will close at six.
Perfect: A new poll has been released.

cards.def:
The number of people who vote.
हिंदी: मतदान प्रतिशत
examples: Present: High turnout favours change.
Past: Turnout reached seventy percent.
Future: Turnout will rise in cities.
Perfect: Turnout has fallen since 2010.

cards.def:
A shift in votes from one party to another.
हिंदी: झुकाव / बदलाव
examples: Present: A swing can change the result.
Past: A swing of five percent decided the seat.
Future: A swing will favour the opposition.
Perfect: A big swing has occurred.

cards.def:
An overwhelming election victory.
हिंदी: भारी बहुमत की जीत
examples: Present: A landslide gives a strong mandate.
Past: She won in a landslide.
Future: A landslide will surprise analysts.
Perfect: The party has secured a landslide.

cards.def:
To admit defeat.
हिंदी: हार मान लेना
examples: Present: Losing candidates usually concede.
Past: He conceded the race at midnight.
Future: She will concede tomorrow.
Perfect: The rival has conceded.

cards.def:
To formally begin or open something.
हिंदी: उद्घाटन करना / पद ग्रहण कराना
examples: Present: Leaders inaugurate new bridges.
Past: The mayor inaugurated the metro line.
Future: The president will be inaugurated in January.
Perfect: The minister has inaugurated the hospital.

cards.def:
The time someone holds an office.
हिंदी: कार्यकाल
examples: Present: A long tenure brings experience.
Past: Her tenure lasted eight years.
Future: His tenure will end in May.
Perfect: His tenure has seen major change.

cards.def:
A person who follows another in a position.
हिंदी: उत्तराधिकारी
examples: Present: A successor takes over duties.
Past: Her successor was named quickly.
Future: A successor will be chosen next month.
Perfect: The party has named a successor.

cards.def:
A person who is faithful to a leader or party.
हिंदी: वफ़ादार समर्थक
examples: Present: A loyalist rarely criticises the leader.
Past: Loyalists filled the cabinet.
Future: Loyalists will defend the plan.
Perfect: He has remained a loyalist.

cards.def:
Disagreement with official opinion.
हिंदी: असहमति
examples: Present: Dissent is vital in a democracy.
Past: The judge wrote a strong dissent.
Future: Dissent will grow if prices rise.
Perfect: The government has crushed dissent.

cards.def:
Strict action against illegal or unwanted behaviour.
हिंदी: सख़्त कार्रवाई
examples: Present: A crackdown follows protests.
Past: Police launched a crackdown on smuggling.
Future: A crackdown will begin next week.
Perfect: The state has ordered a crackdown.

cards.def:
A state of public disturbance.
हिंदी: अशांति
examples: Present: Unrest often follows rising prices.
Past: Unrest spread across the capital.
Future: Unrest will worsen without jobs.
Perfect: Unrest has shaken the region.
